title: Variable-coefficient defect-stable history-resolvent envelope
question: Can the unchanged R-453 source-plus-defect envelope survive a history recurrence with step-dependent nonnegative coefficients kappa_R when a single common upper bound kappa_bar is supplied?
decision_reason: This is the next non-duplicative T-054 analytic interface after R-453. It preserves the established recurrence-resolvent method and owner order while removing an artificial equality requirement: a source owner may submit per-step coefficients together with one uniform upper bound. No finite mobility or geometry table is added and no T-059/T-061 method is changed.
decision_scope: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional variable-coefficient path-product and defect convolution. The result is a reusable admission contract only; it introduces no actual Q3 history, source owner, common domain, finite-grid extrapolation, physical selection, continuum limit, or tier change.
method: Load the hash-pinned R-453/R-452/R-451/R-450 parent contracts and recompute the inherited source decay r=q^4 and A=16*C4_edge*78^4 without fitting.
Unroll H_R<=kappa_R H_(R-1)+A*r^(R-1)+delta_R and bound every path product by kappa_bar^(R-j) only after checking 0<=kappa_R<=kappa_bar at every step.
Keep the exact step-indexed residual convolution, specialize delta_R<=D*s^(R-1), and check unequal-base and resonant closed forms.

Run exact-Fraction primary and non-importing independent checks over the declared radius, bound, defect and coefficient-pattern fixtures; reject hostile coefficient, indexing, threshold, fitting, finite-to-infinite, method and promotion mutations.
Compile Lean R454 and run the integrated verifier while keeping actual Q3 history, source ownership, common domain, exhaustion, common-alpha, physical and continuum fields explicitly open.
finding: For H_0=0 with 0<=kappa_R<=kappa_bar, the exact path-product expansion is bounded by H_R<=A*S_R(kappa_bar,r)+sum_(j=1)^R kappa_bar^(R-j)*delta_j. If delta_j<=D*s^(j-1), this becomes H_R<=A*S_R(kappa_bar,r)+D*S_R(kappa_bar,s), with S_R(kappa_bar,x)=(kappa_bar^R-x^R)/(kappa_bar-x) off resonance and R*x^(R-1) at resonance. The sufficient scalar threshold is kappa_bar<1 and s<1. Primary passes 88,391/88,391, independent 58,939/58,939, hostile rejects 16/16, integrated passes 19/19, and Lean R454 compiles. The source-owned recurrence, coefficient bound, residual, common domain and downstream physical/continuum gates remain missing.
boundary: R-454 proves an abstract scalar implication only: a nonnegative recurrence with step-dependent coefficients bounded by one common kappa_bar has the same source-plus-defect resolvent envelope as the constant upper-bound recurrence. It does not supply the coefficients, kappa_bar, residual, common domain, exhaustion map, or any physical or continuum identification.
evidence_level: T0 exact conditional variable-coefficient defect-stable scalar history-resolvent envelope
assumptions: R-453's source-plus-defect scalar contract is the unchanged parent interface and R-451 supplies its geometric source envelope.
The actual history error and residual are nonnegative scalar quantities in one common norm or form domain.
Each step coefficient kappa_R is nonnegative and is bounded by one common kappa_bar across the intended history and nested-shape family.
The residual is either supplied directly or obeys delta_R<=D*s^(R-1) with common D>=0 and s>=0.
Scalar monotonicity and finite-sum identities are applied before any infinite-limit interpretation.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK derivation of the step coefficients and a common bound kappa_bar<1.
A source-owned residual sequence or common defect envelope and its uniformity in shape, volume, cutoff, beta, phase and history depth.
A common unbounded operator or form domain for H_R, the coefficients and residual.
A production all-shape exhaustion map identifying the same observable across shapes.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, common alpha, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.

adversarial_review.check: Are path products bounded by kappa_bar^(R-j) only after proving 0<=kappa_R<=kappa_bar?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: primary and independent lanes check coefficient domains and domination at every step.

adversarial_review.check: Does residual step j receive kappa_bar^(R-j)?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the exact step-indexed convolution is checked directly.

adversarial_review.check: Does a variable bound silently construct source-owned Q3 dynamics?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: coefficients, recurrence, residual and common bound remain owner hypotheses.

adversarial_review.check: Does either source or defect quotient divide by zero at kappa_bar=x?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: both resonant branches use R*x^(R-1).

adversarial_review.check: Can kappa_bar=1, s=1, or a superunit upper base be admitted to vanishing?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: unit and superunit controls are retained outside the sufficient threshold.

adversarial_review.check: Could pattern/radius rows be read as uniform Q3 or exhaustion evidence?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: rows audit scalar domination only.

adversarial_review.check: Does the variable-coefficient extension replace T-054 or alter T-059/T-061?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive owner-bound refinement of R-453.

adversarial_review.check: Could a common upper-bound envelope be promoted to physical, continuum or Clay closure?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: all downstream scope flags remain false.

stop_or_redesign: If any coefficient is negative or exceeds the submitted kappa_bar, reject that owner packet and retain only the scalar identity.
If kappa_bar>=1 or s>=1, retain the exact conditional diagnostic but do not claim vanishing.
If bounds depend on shape, volume, cutoff, beta or history depth, do not call the envelope uniform.
If no common domain is supplied, do not convert the scalar bound into an operator or form theorem.
If a proposed use changes the established method or owner order, return to the continuity gate before proceeding.
non_claims: No source-owned Q3LOCK recurrence, coefficient sequence, common bound, residual sequence or defect envelope is established.
No common unbounded domain, form closure, source/volume/cutoff/beta uniformity or production exhaustion map is established.
The variable-coefficient envelope is not an OS/KMS/GNS, common-alpha, physical-sector, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap result.
The radius and pattern rows are exact scalar checks and are not a finite-table substitute for an infinite limit.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order and promotion firewalls remain unchanged.
next_action: When a source-owned Q3 history arrives, bound its per-step coefficients by one common kappa_bar and instantiate the residual in this envelope, then feed it to R-453/R-451. Until then, continue the unchanged T-054 owner-intake boundary and additive T-059/T-061 observation-source lock without another finite mobility or geometry table.
